svg.title: kern-chunkwise
svg.desc: Kernel view of chunkwise linear attention (flash-linear-attention). Each chunk of C = 64 tokens does a masked C×C attention and two state matmuls on tensor cores; a 128×128 state passes between chunks. Non-materialized: the state stays in SRAM (64 KiB in FP32) and chunks run in sequence. Materialized: all 512 chunk states for N = 32K go to HBM (32 MiB per head, computed) and chunks run in parallel; GLA reports about 10–20% more memory. Computed per head at N = 32K, d = 128: chunkwise 3.2 GFLOP, all matmul; step-by-step recurrence 2.1 GFLOP, all rank-1; causal softmax 275 GFLOP.
